capabilities: Render :shortcode: custom emoji in Live Preview and Reading view
Search and insert emoji by shortcode after typing a colon
Open a searchable emoji picker from the ribbon or command palette
Import emoji from multiple Mastodon-compatible instances with duplicate-shortcode priority
Browse emoji grouped by instance and server-provided category
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. It makes unauthenticated GET requests to configured instances, caches responses locally, and loads emoji images from instance URLs; it sends no note content or telemetry.
problem: Obsidian cannot render federated custom emoji shortcodes, so notes referencing Mastodon emoji show plain text.

relations.evidence: Render and insert custom emoji from Mastodon and compatible federated instances.

summary: Emoji renderer that displays Mastodon-style :shortcode: custom emoji in notes and inserts them via search or a picker.
